entries.what: Elliot sets up the shared baby-tracker app on his phone and invites Hana and Judith to log feeds and naps, keeping a weekly summary tab in the old spreadsheet.
entries.outcome: Both accepted the invite and Hana logged the evening bottle.

entries.what: Theo comes down with his first cold, so Elliot spends the morning with a nasal aspirator and a humidifier, ignoring Brenda's emails that have piled up for a week.
entries.outcome: Emails still unanswered; he later asks the assistant to help him catch up.

entries.what: Afternoon contact nap on the couch with Theo, then a stroller loop of the courtyard at Marisol Gardens.
entries.outcome: Theo slept 70 minutes, Elliot logged it in the new app.

entries.what: Cold-day routine: humidifier on, extra feeds, a check-in call with Dr. Fong's nurse line about Theo's congestion.
entries.outcome: Told to watch fever and keep fluids up.

entries.what: Elliot does baby laundry in the card-only Marisol Gardens laundry room Tuesday night.
entries.outcome: Two loads done, onesies folded.

entries.what: Takeout dinner from Phở Bến Thành, rare beef no tripe, eaten while Hana holds Theo.
entries.outcome: Hana went to bed early.

entries.what: Rent is paid through the Marisol Gardens portal; Elliot notices Tomás moving boxes into Thao's unit 207 next door.
entries.outcome: Said hello in the hallway and offered to hold the door.

entries.what: An email arrives from the assessor's office saying he must finish online reassessment-software training before returning.
entries.outcome: He bookmarks the training portal to do later.

entries.what: Theo's cold eases; Elliot gets a rare 90-minute stretch while he naps in the crib and works on the lighthouse puzzle.
entries.outcome: Eight pieces placed.

entries.what: After a 2 a.m. feed Elliot is out of ideas for dinner and asks the assistant for a one-handed meal plan, calling himself Employee of the Month at Burnt Toast Inc.
entries.outcome: Got a list of five easy meals using eggs, rice and frozen veg.

entries.what: Thursday 10:30 baby story time at the library with Theo; Kaitlyn leads songs.
entries.outcome: Theo stared at the puppet, Elliot chatted with other parents.

entries.what: Evening witching hour: Elliot hums the slowed-down ballpark organ tune while pacing the hall.
entries.outcome: Crying stopped around 7:40.

entries.what: During Theo's morning nap Elliot asks the assistant for a summary of the new reassessment rules so he isn't behind in January.
entries.outcome: Read the summary and made a short notes list.

entries.what: Afternoon walk with the squeaky-wheeled jogging stroller around the neighborhood.
entries.outcome: Theo fell asleep in the stroller.

entries.what: Friday night baby laundry in the card-only laundry room, then frozen lasagna for dinner.
entries.outcome: Dinner eaten at 8:30.

entries.what: Saturday morning trip to Ruiz Family Market with Theo in the carrier.
entries.outcome: Bought groceries and diapers stayed on delivery.

entries.what: Passing the Ruel Road gas station on an errand, Elliot sees the Henríquez pupusa stand now set up in its lot for the first evening.
entries.outcome: Bought four pupusas to take home.

entries.what: Hana takes Theo for the afternoon so Elliot can nap; he logs the day's feeds into the tracker.
entries.outcome: Got a 90-minute nap.

entries.what: Slow Sunday morning: coffee, a few puzzle pieces, and a check of the weekly summary tab against the app.
entries.outcome: The numbers matched.

entries.what: Family stroller walk to Delgado Park with Hana and Theo.
entries.outcome: Theo napped most of the way.

entries.what: Sunday evening, Elliot plans next week's meals and posts nap targets for the tracker.
entries.outcome: A short grocery list was made.
